overview:
Beste Kijkers is a Dutch comedy news program on the channel RTL 4. The series premiered on September 2, 2015.

A hilarious panel show in which Ruben Nicolai takes viewers through the most entertaining, funny, and moving TV clips of the past week. Two teams featuring a rotating cast of Dutch celebrities—compete against each other to win the episode, led by team captains Jeroen van Koningsbrugge and Beau van Erven Dorens. Their knowledge of the TV clips is tested across four rounds. The goal is to score as many points as possible and go home with the title of 'Beste Kijker' (Best Viewer)!
